html:
SMTO-OUT-0003 — SMTO couldn't format this result for display

GUID: 3644082a-1e01-4ab5-a2b3-39f327567299
Slug: output-projection-invalid
Domain: OUT · Subsystem: out

What happened

  • The step finished and its result is saved, but SMTO couldn't arrange it into the formatted view on screen. The work itself isn't affected.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the step in the activity under the reply to read its saved result. A display fault does not establish that the step failed; its result is saved separately and is still there.
  2. Select Copy error details in this panel and send them to the person who manages SMTO. This is a fault in how SMTO builds the display, and the details show which part failed.
  3. Don't ask the Agent to run the step again to fix the display. Running it again would repeat its actions and would most likely hit the same display problem.

What success looks like

  • You can read the step's result in its activity details.

If it still fails

  • Keep the conversation so the person who manages SMTO can look at the saved result. Don't delete it or change settings to try to fix the display.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Building the display document failed: a display plan section references neither a source operation nor a data reference, its reference is missing from the source lookup, or no registered shape adapter matched the execution result.

What this means

  • A display section cannot resolve its declared operation/data source, or no registered shape adapter matches the execution result. Output extraction, rendering and summaries do not own execution truth. Their failure cannot turn a completed operation into unexecuted work or justify replay; retained exact receipts remain authoritative.

Why this can happen

  • A display section cannot resolve its declared operation/data source, or no registered shape adapter matches the execution result.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the section's exact source reference and result shape against retained authoritative receipts.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the authoritative execution result and the display plan's source_operation_id or source_data_ref (output_pipeline.display_document._source_record, renderers.render_display_plan) and the ShapeAdapterRegistry rules. Report the projection failure with its Error ID; do not rerun completed operations to repair presentation.
  • Preserve and inspect the authoritative execution result. Report the projection failure with its Error ID; do not rerun completed operations to repair presentation.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Presentation renders the same retained evidence through a supported source/adapter.

What not to do

  • Do not delete evidence or invent a configuration change for an unexplained internal failure.

Technical notes

  • Output extraction, rendering and summaries do not own execution truth. Their failure cannot turn a completed operation into unexecuted work or justify replay; retained exact receipts remain authoritative.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
